img: Extreme wide shot from behind: KENJI the samurai stands small in the center of the rain-soaked stone courtyard, back to camera, facing the huge red torii gate far ahead, dark cloak dripping, stone lanterns glowing amber on both sides.
vid: Slow steady camera push-in toward the samurai. Heavy rain falls, lanterns flicker. The samurai stands still.

img: Extreme close-up of KENJI's face, eyes closed, rain running down his face and over the thin vertical scar on his left cheek, wet tied-back hair, warm amber rim light, cold blue fill.
vid: He slowly opens his eyes and stares forward. Raindrops run down his face. Static camera.

img: Extreme close-up insert: a black-armored hand gripping a katana hilt with amber-lit wrapping at the samurai's hip, thumb pressed against the round guard, rain droplets on the black armor.
vid: The armored hand slowly tightens its grip around the katana hilt, leather creaking, rain dripping off the black armor. The sword stays in its scabbard. Static camera.

img: Ground-level close shot of a rain puddle on dark stone pavement reflecting the red torii gate and glowing stone lanterns at night.
vid: The puddle surface trembles with heavy rhythmic impacts, ripple rings spread outward, a stone lantern in the background shakes. Static camera.

img: Wide low-angle shot: the colossal black biomechanical mecha-dragon KURORYU emerges from thick mist behind the red torii gate, glowing amber chest core and neck vents, wings half folded, heavy rain.
vid: The mecha-dragon steps forward out of the mist, raises its head and roars, its chest core flaring brighter. Camera slowly tilts up.

img: Medium close-up of KENJI standing in the rain holding his katana with both hands in front of his chest, determined expression, amber-lit blade, dark cloak.
vid: He raises the katana into a ready stance, rain splashing off the blade. Static camera.

img: Close-up of the mecha-dragon KURORYU's armored head, metal jaws opening, molten amber fire glowing deep inside its throat, rain hissing into steam on the black armor plates.
vid: The jaws open wider and the fire inside the throat grows brighter and brighter, steam rising. Slight camera push-in.

img: Wide shot of the empty rain-soaked temple courtyard with stone lanterns, a torrent of orange dragon fire entering from the right edge of the frame.
vid: A massive stream of dragon fire sweeps across the courtyard from right to left, rain flashing into steam, a stone lantern knocked over. Static camera.

img: Medium shot of KENJI sprinting toward the camera through rain and steam in the temple courtyard, katana held low in his right hand, cloak flying, orange fire glow behind him.
vid: He runs fast straight toward the camera, splashing water. Camera tracks backward with him.

img: Low-angle shot of KENJI leaping high into the stormy night sky, dark silhouette against a lightning flash, katana raised overhead with both hands, cloak spread.
vid: He rises through the air with the katana raised overhead, rain streaking past, lightning flashes. Slow motion.

img: Extreme close-up of a glowing amber katana blade mid-swing slicing through falling raindrops against a dark stormy background.
vid: The blade sweeps diagonally across the frame in slow motion, leaving a bright amber light trail, raindrops splitting apart.

img: Close-up of the mecha-dragon KURORYU's glowing amber chest core with a fresh bright diagonal slash wound cut across it, sparks flying, black armor plates.
vid: Cracks spread across the glowing core, sparks and molten light burst out, the armor plates buckle. Static camera.

img: Wide shot of the mecha-dragon KURORYU collapsing onto the wet stone courtyard in front of the red torii gate, chest core sputtering, steam and sparks, rain.
vid: The defeated dragon slumps down and lies motionless on the wet stone, a burst of steam and water splash, its glowing chest core slowly fades to dark. It stays down and does not get up. Static camera.

img: Medium shot of KENJI kneeling on one knee on the wet stone pavement after landing, katana in his right hand, rain pouring, steam drifting behind him.
vid: He slowly slides the katana back into the scabbard at his hip and lowers his head. Rain continues. Static camera.

img: Wide shot from behind KENJI standing in the rainy courtyard facing the red torii gate, the dark smoking wreck of the mecha-dragon lying motionless beyond the gate, amber lantern glow.
vid: Slow camera pull-back. Rain falls, smoke rises from the wreck, the samurai stands still.
